projectState.summary: Byte L4b is implemented on codex/byte-l4b-idea-catalog and ready for Claude review. The melody editor now has a per-song idea catalog scoped to editor-<songId>, showing generated prosody plus non-purged saved/evolved phrase candidates sorted by fitness. Browsing renders selected ideas read-only without mutating persistence or the audible override; explicit Preview reuses editorMelodyOverride, and Edit this idea seeds L3 edit mode for native anchor-phrase/v1 genomes while legacy flat candidates remain view-only. No persistence endpoint/schema/server/scorer/transport/scheduler path changed. Validation: build green, six unit suites green, smoke 76/76, db:smoke green, diff-check green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories.
